payload.reason: The evidence indicates that among the three pretraining tasks, SR (Sentence Reordering) is the most effective for improving performance in summarization tasks.

claims.text: SR is the most effective task for pre-training as it consistently achieves the highest ROUGE-2 scores on both CNNDM and NYT datasets.
SR works slightly better than the other two tasks (NSG and MDG) during pre-training.
Using all three tasks together (ALL) can outperform individual tasks, but SR remains the most effective when more data is added.
